subject: Life Skills
title: When to Walk Away
description: A 60-second lesson on When to Walk Away.

hook.text: He stayed in a toxic friendship for years because leaving felt like giving up. Staying cost him his confidence.

buildup.text: The sunk cost fallacy keeps people in bad situations. 'I have invested so much' becomes a chain, not a reason.

discovery.text: Walking away is not failure. It is a decision that your future matters more than your past investment.

twist.text: You do not need the other person to agree that it is over. Waiting for permission to leave gives them control.

climax.text: Ask yourself: if I met this person today with no history, would I choose this relationship? If not, the answer is clear.

punchline.text: Leaving is not quitting. It is choosing yourself.

quiz.question: What keeps people stuck in toxic relationships the longest?
options: The sunk cost fallacy — feeling too invested to leave
